channel.title: SuperRobots Tutorials
channel.description: Engaging programming games and Python tutorials.

item.title: How Block Coding Prepares Kids for Python
item.description: Discover how the logical foundations built by snapping blocks together perfectly translate into real-world text-based programming in Python.

item.title: Debugging Like a Pro: Finding & Fixing Bugs
item.description: Learn essential debugging strategies for young coders. Discover how to read error messages, use print statements, and systematically squash bugs in your Python code.

item.title: Top 5 Algorithms Every FLL Team Should Know
item.description: Improve your robot's reliability and precision on the FIRST LEGO League mat by understanding these five fundamental pathfinding and alignment algorithms.

item.title: Introduction to Conditionals: Teaching Your Robot to Decide
item.description: Learn how if-else statements let your robot make decisions. A beginner-friendly guide to conditionals, boolean logic, and branching in Python.

item.title: Mastering Loops: The Key to Efficiency
item.description: A deep dive into why loops are essential in programming. Learn how to identify repetitive tasks and automate them using while and for loops.

item.title: 10 Beginner Python Projects for Kids
item.description: 10 fun and achievable Python projects perfect for kids and beginners. Build real programs from a number guessing game to a simple text adventure — no experience needed.

item.title: Python vs. Scratch: Which Should Kids Learn First?
item.description: Comparing Python and Scratch for young learners. Discover which coding language is best for your child's age, goals, and learning style — and how to transition between them.

item.title: Understanding Variables: Your Robot's Memory
item.description: Learn what variables are and how they work as your robot's memory. A beginner-friendly guide to storing and using data in Python.

item.title: What Is an Algorithm? Robot Thinking Explained
item.description: What is an algorithm, explained for kids. Learn how computers and robots follow step-by-step instructions to solve problems — with fun, real-world examples.
